description: Schema for shell entities that represent saved shell configurations (command, run mode, working directory, and arguments). Shell entities are launched against a host chosen at open time and are not used for ephemeral shells.

mode.description: Run mode for the saved configuration. 'pty' spawns a pseudo-terminal (interactive programs, colors, and mouse tracking); 'pipe' redirects stdin/stdout without a terminal (non-interactive capture).

working-directory.description: Absolute path on the host where the shell starts. If not specified, uses the host's default.

environment.description: Extra environment variables layered over the host defaults. Keys and values are strings.
